content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: rollout-service-prod — post-deploy 5xx spike (>4.5% over baseline). Alert ID: PD-89231. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollout-5xx

pagerduty-bot: Incident triggered: severity=sev2, service=rollout-service-prod, escalation_policy=oncall-sre. Pager: Maya (eng-oncall).

Maya: acked :hand: taking lead. Jumping into quick triage. Which region is most affected?

Rafael: us-east-1 looks worst. p95 latency and 5xx concentrated on /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate. Spike started ~2m after the deploy. I pulled logs — tokenizer OOM-ish traces followed by transient 500s.

Rafael: ```
2025-09-12T21:12:23Z rollout-service tokenzier[pid=4123] OOM while allocating 128MB
2025-09-12T21:12:24Z http-handler 500 POST /v1/embeddings user=svc-frontend
2025-09-12T21:12:25Z kv-cache purged prefix=embed-kv region=us-east-1
```

Priya: hmm. The new quant kernel in v3.4.1 was supposed to reduce mem, but looks like a regression on long-context requests. Can we confirm if only embedding model variants are hit?

Tom: quick metrics: error-rate by model variant: embed-large: 12.1% (us-east-1), gen-base: 0.8% overall, gen-rlhf: 0.5%. So embeddings are the culprit.

Maya: ok plan proposal: 1) Pause rollout (stop next batch), 2) Divert traffic for embeddings to previous stable pool (v3.4.0) in us-east-1, 3) If diversion fails, rollback v3.4.1 in us-east-1. Who can run the traffic switch?

Tom: I can run the traffic split. Command: ```
# switch embeddings traffic back to stable
redwood traffic update --service rollout-service --route embeddings --from v3.4.1 --to v3.4.0 --percent 100 --region us-east-1
```

Tom: executing now.

incident-bot: action started: traffic-split PD-ACTION-334.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded: Maya. Escalation halted while mitigation in progress.

Tom: traffic switch returned: status=applied, routing-commit=rc-20250912-01. Health checks: passing=2/3 initially, now 3/3.

Maya: seeing error-rate drop from 4.6% -> 0.6% in us-east-1 for embeddings within 90s. Nice.

Rafael: can we still reproduce locally? I grabbed a failing request repro (context ~12k tokens) and replayed against v3.4.1 — memory climbs, GC churn, then 500. Against v3.4.0 it succeeds. Sending snippet to #eng-ml for kernel triage.

Priya: good catch. We should still do a targeted rollback in us-east-1 for the rollout-service to be safe and free up capacity. Traffic diversion buys us time but not a permanent fix.

Maya: agreement: Rafael + Priya to file model/quant regression ticket. Tom please perform a rollback for us-east-1. Keep canary paused globally.

Tom: running rollback: ```
redwood deploy rollback --service rollout-service --to v3.4.0 --region us-east-1 --reason "embed 5xx regression"
```

incident-bot: Rollback initiated by Tom. Watch: https://redwood.internal/deploys/rollback/rc-20250912-01

Tom: rollback in progress — pod scale events: terminating 12 pods, starting 12 older-version pods. Health checks rolling.

Elaine (Support): quick customer check — outbound monitoring shows 3 paid accounts had increased error rates (acct-129, acct-442, acct-771). No support tickets yet. I'll pre-draft a status note for customers and ops.

Maya: thanks Elaine. Priority: get stable live, then send customer note with ETA.

Tom: rollback completed in us-east-1. Post-rollback checks: 5xx -> baseline (0.4%), p95 restored. No elevated CPU or memory now.

Rafael: collecting logs and artifacts and saving to incident folder: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD-89231/artifacts

Priya: filing regression issue: RED-INC-2247 with reproduction steps, model trace, and suggested rollback-protection flags. Tagging eng-ml and infra-kernel.

Maya: updating PagerDuty incident to status=mitigated, leaving page open for 30m watch. Please monitor metrics for 60m. If stable, we'll close.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-89231 updated to mitigated_by=rollout-rollback (Maya). Auto-close window=30m.

Tom: handing over to night oncall: I'll + hand-off to Rafael for 4h watch. Rafael please confirm you'll take post-rollback monitoring.

Rafael: taking post-rollback watch. Will watch error-rate, latency, and nodes for 4h. If anything creeps, escalate to Maya/Priya.

Maya: thanks all. Follow-ups: - run full canary bake check before reattempting v3.4.1, - eng-ml to validate quant kernel memory with long-context tests, - update runbook with embedding-quant fallback recipe. I'll open the incident ticket and assign owners.

Elaine (Support): sending customer status (internal draft) to #customer-ops for review now.

incident-bot: Note: handoff recorded — primary=Maya, secondary=Rafael, mitigations=traffic-split+rollback, incident-folder=PD-89231.

Maya: closing thread in 30m if nothing else. :white_check_mark:
